timing: Post-incident rules and implementation are committed before the first full execution of the new audit. Original-machine diagnostic arrays and traces were collected after the incident. This is not prospective preregistration of the original experiment or a new independent test.
proposition: Consistency of the original recorded measurements, fixed models, calibration, complete sets, operating decisions, costs and acceptance under explicitly conditional arithmetic assumptions
excluded_propositions: Bitwise or full closed-loop trajectory equivalence on another numerical backend
Causal proof of historical training execution
New independent samples, policy superiority, reached-state CP coverage or deployment authorization
unchanged: Original 45/46/48 and their frozen source manifests and numerical tolerances
Original primary and small-sample protocols, raw evidence, model weights, T, q, labels, sizes and test populations
Original negative_stop policy acceptance and paused complex risk research
numeric_obligations: 80-digit outward Decimal interval forward equations from binary64 weights, normalization and features
Operation-count gamma bounds for dot products and sums; relative rounding and amplified absolute underflow terms; reject unresolved overflow or invalid domains
Explicit conditional elementary-function and backend assumptions retained in every certificate and release
Actual post-incident original-host golden traces: all 60 geometries, NLL enclosures, branches and returned T verified
Independent inverse-temperature convex NLL minimizer enclosure, recorded objective gap, and rounding-budget propagation; no enlarged T tolerance
Clipped NLL regions excluded by separately outward lower-bounded convex tangents with deterministic bisection; unresolved bounds reject
Strict finite-sample CP rank and exact recorded q from the independent CP population; interval order-statistic certificate and complete recorded sets
Recorded probabilities independently enclosed before they reconstruct any executed action
Every recorded operating state, feedback chain, typed proposal, hold/escalation mode, bounded update, actual measurement, cache, stop and returned best point verified
For a budget stop, interval propagation includes terminal log1p feedback and proves the next proposal cannot equal any cached tuple; unresolved cache boundaries reject
Independent objective/filter, MSE, observation and teacher replay for all recorded candidates; exact baseline proposal/request reconstruction
All nine supplemental calibration rows, split/model/source bindings, observed clock samples, statistics and diagnostics checked without refitting or substituting clocks

execution.parent_objective_evaluations: Count every actual independent filter replay, including work before failures
execution.roster: Every recorded case; no performance-based selection
execution.receipts: Immutable UUID success/failure receipts; collect all worker outcomes and preserve source hashes before/after
execution.source_freeze: Require committed audit implementation and this source manifest before complete execution

acceptance: All specified original-record obligations must pass. A passing conditional audit is a new, explicitly named proposition and never reclassifies the retained strict replay failures as passes.
failure_action: Preserve the failure and costs. Do not change policy, thresholds, sample sizes, tolerances or source data to obtain a pass. Any audit implementation repair requires a documented new frozen revision before another full execution.
numeric_assumptions:
Independent Decimal audit, not a replacement inference/calibration runtime.

Arithmetic assumes IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest (including fused/reordered
dot products bounded by gamma(2*n+1)), gradual underflow, and faithful (<= one
ulp) exp/tanh/log/log1p implementations. Decimal exp/ln are correctly rounded; their
adjacent Decimal numbers enclose the real result. Certificates are conditional
on those explicit elementary-function assumptions, not bitwise replay proofs.
No bound is fitted to observed residuals. All public results are JSON-safe.
